name: DJI RoboMaster M2006 P36 Brushless DC Gear Motor

files.embedded_colours: none (no STYLED_ITEM entities; any COLOUR_RGB entries are an unlinked palette)

tessellated_bbox_mm.note: world-space bbox of occt-import-js tessellation, includes cables/connectors

products.name: M2006 P36 3
products.role: single product; geometry is ONE SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL (no MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP) made of 35 shells

shell_roles_inferred_occt_mesh_index.18-34: lead-end connector (15.2 x 15.2 x 5.3 housing) and terminals

license: No explicit license on the CAD. Published by DJI (SZ DJI Technology Co., Ltd.) as a free public download on the official RoboMaster site for customers integrating the product. DJI user guides state the product and documents are copyrighted by DJI, all rights reserved, no reproduction without written consent. Treat as proprietary: OK for internal reference/rendering, ask DJI before redistributing the raw STEP.

dims_mm.output_shaft: 6 mm with D-flat (5.50 -0.10), radial through hole 3 mm, axial M3 thread depth 5.5
dims_mm.mounting: 3x M3-6H depth 4 EQS on the output face; 3x M2-6H depth 3 EQS on the rotor end
dims_mm.cad_check: CAD Z extent 64.8 and OD 24.4 match

colors.housing: matte black anodized aluminium (motor and gearbox)
colors.band: thin copper/bronze ring visible at the gap between upper and lower black sections (winding/air gap)
colors.branding: white 'R ROBOMASTER' logo and 'M2006 P36' text; one black Phillips screw on the side

notes: Official SolidWorks 2016 export 2018-02-06. Surface model rather than solids (17 open + 18 closed shells), fine for rendering but not watertight per part. No product names: the gearbox is separable only by shell, not by name. Reduction 36:1. Only a Chinese user guide exists for the M2006; specs cross-checked against the English product API.
